metric_refs.subject: Ocean Trading CEO test email OCE-20 2026-06-11
metric_refs.failure_pattern: Riley produced planning/JSON send intents but no Gmail message id before recovery.

summary: For Ocean Trading email tasks, completion requires a real Gmail connector send plus durable proof fields: recipient, subject, UTC send time, and Gmail message id. A JSON object such as send_test_email is only an intent and must never be treated as delivery proof. MCP Gmail tools must be invoked through the runtime tool interface, not as PowerShell command names.

Job Search morning self-delivery emails should show both qualified and disqualified jobs, and each job row should include the source website or source label. Include source counts and source errors in the email body so blocked or failing sources are visible to Wayne without opening logs.

Approval-gated Job Search recruiter replies can be present in issue documents and comments even when the Paperclip approvals endpoint returns no pending approval records. Before acting on a supposed pending email, inspect the issue document, comments, local Gmail-check report, and Gmail state; never send or create an external recruiter/employer reply unless Wayne explicitly approves that specific message.

Draft outbound Job Search recruiter/employer replies in Wayne's first person, as if Wayne wrote them directly. Do not refer to Wayne in the third person inside the outbound email body. Use `Regards,` followed by `Wayne` as the default sign-off, not `Best, Wayne`. A user rejection of a specific draft for other reasons does not invalidate this voice and sign-off preference.

metric_refs.email_subject: Job Search Midday Routine Results - 12 Jun 2026

summary: Routine recovery for Job Search is not complete until the rerun succeeds and the self-delivery Gmail send is confirmed with a real message id. Generating the body and zip package is necessary but not sufficient; close the recovery only after Gmail delivery proof is present.

metric_refs.failure_mode: Paper trade opened in one UTC TradeActivityLog file and closed in the next; dashboard parser lost position context while email and dashboard summary P/L used dailyNetProfitLossDollars instead of the reconciled closed-trade set.

summary: For Ocean Trading paper trade emails and dashboard totals, summary counts and realized long/short/net P/L must come from the same reconciled closed-trade set used by the dashboard calendar and trade table. Do not substitute Sierra dailyNetProfitLossDollars for side, net, or dashboard Total P/L because it can omit cross-file closes or represent a different account/day scope. Preserve parser state across UTC TradeActivityLog files so opens and closes spanning midnight are included exactly once.
